passages.text:
Jud and Dave,
I have gone back to our team here and they have been in touch with George Alafoginis who I believe is in the global
marketing division. The focus thus far has been in three areas:
1) Working together to provide local beneficiary groups in USAID Office of Transition Initiative's program countries with
training, analytics, and advocacy advice on the use of Facebook as a tool for organizing people around social issues.
2) Better access to Facebook analytics to understand target audiences in the countries where we work.
3) Assisting Facebook to identify, in countries where we work, elements utilizing the platform in violation of FB's Terms of
Use in order to promote violence and hate speech.
Initially the teams have discussed potential engagement with on Sri Lanka, Kenya and Honduras, but our program in
Tunisia has also expressed an interest. It seems that Kenya would likely be the first place we move forward, given
Facebook's interest andthe fact that our team out there has a concrete proposal for how they could work together.
I have cc'd Nealin Parker who is OTI's acting Director and Joe McSpedon who is spearheading this from our side. I do
think there is a real opportunity for partnership. Our team would also be open to other ideas you may have, in addition to
the three points laid out above.
OTI is at the cutting edge on using technology to maximize impact and the team there is phenomenal. I hope our teams
are able to continue this conversation and please let me know if there are any questions.
Best,
Andrew
